tools.name: process_video
tools.description: Start clipping a video from its URL. AIClipMaker.org downloads the source itself, transcribes it, finds the most viral moments with AI and renders vertical (9:16) clips. Captions are burned by default. Takes the URL as the user gave it; the video does not need to be opened or transcribed beforehand.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Status of a processing job: 'queued', 'processing', 'completed' or 'failed', with recent log lines and, once completed, the clips.

tools.name: list_clips
tools.description: The clips of a completed job, with titles, platform-ready descriptions and download URLs. In MCP Apps-capable clients the result also renders as an interactive clip picker.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: The authenticated user's plan and remaining processing minutes. Call before large jobs; process_video fails with quota_exceeded when the balance is insufficient.

tools.name: add_subtitles
tools.description: Re-style the captions of one clip (clips already ship with the 'default' preset). Easiest: pass a preset; any other field you send overrides that part of it. Without a preset, style 'karaoke' highlights the active word.

tools.name: recut_clip
tools.description: Re-render one clip from a new list of source-video segments (the same engine behind the dashboard's clip editor). findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_clips · Public sink: add_subtitles · Destructive: recut_clip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_clips · Public sink: add_subtitles · Destructive: recut_clip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
